name: @software-factory/skills
description: A self-improving software factory for coding agents: triage, spec, isolate, build, prove, ship, and monitor, plus an outer loop that measures every run, remembers what agents learn, routes work to the cheapest capable model, and proposes skill fixes as reviewed PRs. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and 75 more agents.
author: Aditya Deokar

scripts.test: node scripts/lint-skills.mjs && node scripts/sync-shared.mjs --check && node scripts/check-package.mjs && node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs && python -m pytest tests/ -q
scripts.prepublishOnly: node scripts/lint-skills.mjs && node scripts/sync-shared.mjs --check && node scripts/check-package.mjs
